subject: [PATCH 2/6] mm/page_owner: hold off memory offline while a page is read

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch prevents memory offline operations from interfering with the reading of page ownership information in /sys/kernel/debug/page_owner. It does this by moving the check for online pages inside a read section and reordering code to avoid sleeping locks while holding hotplug locks. This fix addresses an issue where reading page owner information could cause kernel oops when memory is being removed or offline.
